adjudication.rationale: Diff adds nontrivial controller logic in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (e.g., `save_host` pulls `params[:embeddable_host][:host]`/`[:category_id]`, defaults blank category to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`, and renders serialized success vs `render_json_error`) and in `Admin::EmbeddingController` (`fetch_embedding` builds an `OpenStruct` with `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)`). However the new specs (`spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb` and `spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb`) only assert the controllers subclass `Admin::AdminController`, and do not exercise any of the new behaviors (param handling, defaulting, error paths, or missing-record handling in `update`/`destroy` where `where(...).first` could be nil). This is a concrete, diff-grounded coverage gap rather than a proven runtime defect.
